
`GET /approvals/{id}` shows one approval, the entity it governs, its full
decision history and the review-graph references its designation recorded.
Its only acts are an open impact review's note and decision (the owner of a
dependent explains what an upstream change means; a qualified prior approver
confirms or reopens) and the self-review exception, offered only where the
project's flow policy permits one. Approval displays name exact version,
actor, role, time, source and any policy exception.
